As required by Section 14A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, this proposal seeks a shareholder advisory vote to
approve the compensation of our NEOs as disclosed pursuant to Item 402 of Regulation

through the following resolution:
“Resolved, that shareholders approve the Firm’s compensation practices and principles and their implementation for 2018 for the compensation of the
Firm’s Named Executive Officers as discussed and disclosed in the Compensation Discussion and Analysis, the compensation tables, and any related material contained in this proxy statement.”
Because this is an advisory vote, it will not be binding upon the Board of Directors. However, the CMDC will take into account the outcome of the vote when considering
future executive compensation arrangements.
